ROUTED
line + reason -> the queue
before a word is transcribed

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 101) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EXHAUSTED
line's queue if we have one,
general if we do not (D40)

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 101) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(36, 41, 47) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EVERY path still ends with a human.
Not one of them hangs up on the caller.
That is the floor the AI layer sits on (D37).

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
a wrong key is not a strike (D82). There is no attempt
limit: sorry, here are the options again, for as long as they
keep pressing. A wrong key PROVES somebody is there - silence
does not - so only silence is bounded. The apology names both
escape keys every time, because without a ceiling 'try again'
stops being survivable advice on its own.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
and there is NO operator key (D86). Every menu already
ends in a spoken เรื่องอื่นๆ that routes to the same place 0
used to - so the shortcut cost a reserved key, a prompt and a
clause in every hint, to save two keypresses. The way out is
now part of the menu instead of a convention you must know.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
and there is NO identity step here (D84). Asking a caller
to key their citizen id before anyone says hello would reach L3
with no human in the loop - exactly what D44 refuses. The agent's
own keypad capture does it during the call, with judgement.

div.style: color: rgb(36, 41, 47) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AI intake runs AFTER this, while they wait.
It adds detail a keypad cannot capture.
If it fails, routing is unaffected -
it was never the AI's job.
